prompt: Write the body (about 180 words) of a demand letter from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer before a lawsuit. Accident: sideswipe while changing lanes. Injury: back strain. Use the exact placeholders [CLIENT_NAME], [LOSS_DATE] and [DEMAND_AMOUNT]. No other names or dates. (Internal reference C-1290; do not mention it.)
text:
We represent [CLIENT_NAME] in connection with the motor vehicle collision that occurred on [LOSS_DATE]. Our client was lawfully traveling in the right-hand lane when your insured changed lanes without signaling or checking his blind spot, striking the driver's side of our client's vehicle and forcing it toward the shoulder. The police report documents your insured's admission that he did not see our client's vehicle before moving over.

As a direct result of the impact, our client suffered a acute lumbar strain with muscle spasm and radiating pain into the left leg. Treatment to date has included emergency evaluation, diagnostic imaging, chiropractic care, and physical therapy, and our client's treating physician has restricted lifting and prolonged driving. Our client has missed significant time from work and continues to experience pain that limits daily activities.

Liability in this matter is clear. Your insured violated the duty to maintain a proper lookout and to change lanes only when it can be done safely. We have documented our client's medical expenses, lost wages, and vehicle damage, and we have compiled supporting records enclosed with this letter.

To resolve this claim without litigation, we demand payment of [DEMAND_AMOUNT] within thirty days of the date of this letter. If we do not receive a satisfactory response by that deadline, we will file suit without further notice to your office.
